name: Awayleg
summary: Awayleg is a casual multiplayer football (soccer) management game played in the browser. Each player founds or takes over a club in their real-world town and climbs their country's league pyramid of 16-club tiers, where bot clubs hold the seats until human managers replace them. Players pick the starting eleven, trade on a shared transfer market and run the club's finances, while every match is simulated automatically and plays out live in real time on a 3D pitch. Real travel distance and real local weather affect results. One real day is one matchweek, with evening kickoffs on each country's clock.
